label: preparing
what: A discreet gathering at the town hall for day 1 at eighteen, involving 200 fresh loaves and eight installed hall lanterns, coordinated with the scheduled lighting review. Builder is arranging it and accepted the 101-emerald bread debt; innkeeper and freight handle bread supplies, with baker implicated in the bread order. Secretary knowingly assists with arrangements and payer confirmation. It may celebrate my forty years as mayor, but that purpose remains speculation, not confirmed. Neighbour knows about lanterns and deliveries, but knowing participation is unproven.
